items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: We had Pigment Markham at one time at the Apollo with us, too.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

acts among us were the big name bracket, like Billie Holiday, she was with us for a while and then we had the Delta Rhythm Boys and the Two Zephyrs, I remember that act and also -- I can't think of the acts that were with us. We had Pigment Markham at one time at the Apollo with us, too. Most of the time we had Billie Holiday. I got to know Billie Holiday very, very well -- very close because she liked the way I blew my horn and she also was a great personality and usually closed the show and I can't think of who…
Did she have you play with her sometimes? Did she ask you to come out and play with her?
